story.so_that: I can durably automate complete multi-step workflows of agentic action
story.as_a: Software Engineer, and AI Process Designer
story.i_want: a working example of the Story Analysis Workflow of the SDLC process using a publicly available workflow engine

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: The implemented workflow is documented and can be used by others
Workflow is repeatable, producing similar results when given the same inputs
Workflow actions are auditable and traceable after workflow completion
Domain/task-list scoping: only Workers and clients configured for the workflow's Cadence domain and task list can start, signal, or execute it

related_edge_cases.criterion: First-time use: no Cadence domain registered yet
Worker crash mid-Activity and workflow resumption via replay
Very large story document exceeds Cadence input/Activity payload size limits

steps.description: Author a docker-compose.yml that runs the `ubercadence/server` image configured for embedded-SQLite persistence (no CASSANDRA_SEEDS, no Cassandra container) plus the Cadence Web UI, exposing the gRPC frontend (7833) and Web UI (8088) ports
Bring the stack up with `docker compose up` and verify the Cadence server and Web UI are reachable
artifacts: running `cadence` container reachable at 127.0.0.1:7833; Web UI reachable at http://localhost:8088

steps.description: Register the domain and task list using the cadence CLI (or its Docker image) against the composed stack
artifacts: cadence task list 'story-analysis' configured (task lists are created on worker poll; 'story-analysis' is the configured task list)

steps.description: Verify the SQLite-backed server is reachable from the Python client (no Cassandra dependency) and confirm persistence config
Write the README/runbook for starting the docker-compose stack and registering the domain
